clips.text: The quietest room on Earth is twenty-five decibels below silence — and it will deafen you.
You sit in the quietest room on Earth. The door seals shut. The silence starts roaring.
Then you hear it — your heartbeat, like a drum.
Blood moving. Stomach gurgling. The quieter the room, the louder you get.
Hand to your chest — boom, boom, boom. You came for silence. You found yourself.
So why can you hear your own heartbeat in the quietest room on Earth?
In a room with no echo, your ears turn up until the only sound left is you — and the famous 45-minute limit is a lie. Tap the video link under my name.
